container_remove.value: postgres and redis and its writable layer will be deleted. Volumes are kept. This cannot be undone.

container_restart.value: postgres and redis will go down for a moment and come back. Open connections are dropped.

container_stop.value: postgres and redis will get SIGTERM and stop. Nothing is removed; start brings it back.

image_prune.value: Frees about 634MB. Images that a container uses are kept.

palette_run.value: postgres and redis will get SIGTERM and stop. Nothing is removed; start brings it back.

volume_prune.value: Deletes their data and frees about 3.2GB. This cannot be undone.
